description: okf knowledge-base hooks (same three as .claude/settings.json). Trust them once with /hooks in Codex.

hooks.command: f="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/.okf/okf-py.sh"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then sh "$f" session-start;  fi
f="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/.okf/okf-py.sh"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then sh "$f" hook;  fi
f="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/.okf/okf-py.sh"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then sh "$f" stop-gate; else echo '{}'; fi
